atlas.brief: Original Brazilian fantasy kite-creature RPG environment atlas, nine separated modules in 3x3 layout. Elevated orthographic three-quarter 2:1 ground directions; thin petrol outlines, warm upper-left sunlight, broad cel-shaded planes. Terracotta, cream, petrol, gold, warm greens. Row 1 detached canopy, matching trunk, smaller complete tree. Row 2 hexagonal open coreto, wood/petrol bench, flowering shrub. Row 3 bare windsock mast, separate striped windsock fabric, separate seven-flag bunting. No text, UI or scenery; transparent background.
atlas.reference_role: As três imagens do usuário orientam vista elevada, volumes e coerência da cena. Objetos originais descritos no prompt, sem extração dos screenshots.

canopy_edit.input: canopy.png do primeiro recorte do atlas
canopy_edit.brief: Remove all three golden kite ornaments and their ribbons, replacing them with matching green leaf masses. Preserve canopy silhouette, lime/petrol-green layered leaves, outlines, upper-left lighting and elevated three-quarter view. Detached ordinary tree canopy, no trunk, additional objects or background. Transparent output.
